Research: Offline engineering only; no scientific operating point or actual authorization proof
Design: Explicit P1 bundle layout, source-preserving policy projection, synthetic parent catalog and evidence-limited comparison
Deviation: This parent preparation contract adds catalog admission outside previously read-only DYN03. Snapshot checkpoint-start/suffix optimization is not provided by the unchanged RunPolicies APIs.
no_fixed_contract_change: Original v1/v2 DTOs, canonical/hash domains, policy math and native error identities remain unchanged. This document defines parent I/O/preparation boundaries only.
numeric_scope: This document does not resolve or override the separately demonstrated zero-auxiliary/subnormal ranking contradiction. No completed DYN05/pilot claim until all required gates pass.

G1.selected_candidate: For --p1-manifest absolute path, the base file is exactly dynamics-manifest.json in that same ordinary directory. No search/CWD/env/digestfilename guessing/newflag/newDTO.
G1.binding: Strict-decode and verify wrapper semantic selfhash. BaseDynamicManifestSHA256 matches the strict base DynamicInputManifestV2 semantic ManifestSHA256; raw role files retain exact rawhash/size separately. Wrapper-to-base is one explicit binding, not recursive manifestrole traversal.
G1.roots: Base RoleFile paths resolve against that shared manifestdirectory under existing secure ordinary bounded read rules. Actual registryargv rawfile must match registryrole rawhash+size and cfg.Registry semanticvalue; source roles and required subset fixed.
G1.p1_identity: cfg.input_manifest_sha256 and output run.input_manifest_sha256 bind the selected P1wrapper semanticSHA; no-feature path binds base manifest semanticSHA. If base lists features in addition to wrapper, require exactsame RoleFile; no competing alternatefeature payload.

identity_domains.DynamicsRunConfigV2.InputManifestSHA256: selected argv manifest semantic selfhash: P1wrapper forP1,base forlegacy
identity_domains.PredictionRunV2.InputManifestSHA256: same semantic identity as run config
identity_domains.OutputManifest.InputManifestSHA256: actual selected argv manifest raw bytes SHA256, per original output_artifact_contract
identity_domains.OutputManifest.RunConfigSHA256: typed full run config semantic ConfigSHA256

G2.native_scope: This new native P1 parent bundle has one stream/clock/scope/dimension source context. Stateful scalar run subsets require that context across events and probes, following existing single-namespace snapshots. Reject mixed input explicitly, never filter or renumber accepted_seq. This is an added bundle preparation precondition, not a claim that every shape-valid EventFile combination was already restricted or that general multi-scope baseline inputs are unsupported. Existing stateless RankPolicy and v1 APIs remain unchanged; any broader stateless RunPolicies support must not be narrowed silently.
G2.schedule: Every selected cfg.policy_ids policy has the exact samequeryIDset; raw Probe rows already carry actualpolicyID/version. Allperquery rows match scope/dimension/at/cutoff/candidateSnapshotID+SHA/final_k/budget. No unselected scheduled row silently dropped. Preserve fixed policy/prediction orders.
G2.immutable_source: Validate exact input artifacts/registry/fullcfg and rawsource event selfhashes first. Raw exogenous input stays unchanged. Within stateful policy copies rewrite only EventFile.config_sha256 and each Event.key.config_sha256 to that registered policyDynamics SHA, then recompute actual Event payload and prefix canonicalprojections. Never rewrite sourceID/ref/revision/scope/dimension/clock/times/acceptedseq/transport/task/evidence/outcome/strength/reason. Distincttargetcfgs naturally yield distinctprefix hashes.
G2.probe_prefix: Policy-bound rawprobe.prefix must equal that policy derivedprefix atcutoff; no blindcopy of commonprefix into differentconfig. Nonstate B0/B1/IR use originalsource prefix anchor because they have no dynamicscfg; no inventedscalar state or config. Compare source cohorts byoriginalmanifest/schedulebinding, not equality of differentcfg prefixhashstrings.
G2.processing: Process computations in nondecreasingcutoff, preserving physicaleventdeliveryorder and exactretry. Restore fixed outputordering; do not sort events or mutate supplied probes. Reuse actualReplayPrefix/ReadAt/ApplyEvent/ResetRevision and canonical helpers, not a second transitionengine.
G2.seed_and_admission: Synthetic offline seed has nonnil empty states/receipts/consumptions, cursorseq0/time0/typedinitialprefix, namespace synthetic/epoch1/minimumseq0 emptylifecyclefence. Immediately before a NEW real activation of an unseen exactfullkey, parent admits that exacttarget as a current syntheticfence entry (source_refs empty if no declaredsource), sorts/seals catalog/index/snapshot, preserving epoch/minseq. It does not create active state; only existing transition of the actualactivate does. No admission on retry/nonactivate; same-revision/hashaliases reject before admission. Source invalidation transitions continue to alter fence epoch/status via originalrules. Never seed from futureevent body/candidateactiveflags or claim real DB/authority proof.
G2.incremental_use: Native runner may advance the policyaccepted snapshot one actualdelivery at a time by ReplayPrefix; queryReadAt writesnothing. Exactretry witholdseq usescurrentcursorcutoff to avoid falsely movingbackwards. Keepallactivated keys/receipts, no pruning. Policy/state/receipt/cursor outputs deeplyowned.
G2.snapshot_role_pending: Selected: consume optional SnapshotFileV2 as the CLI-only consistency witness below, not runner seed. No hidden file/global/config argument channel. Full policy replay remains required.
G2.costs: EventInputs actualsource deliveryrows processed perpolicy; UniqueEvents unique exogenousIDs; DuplicateEvents actualtransportretries; DuplicateEvidence actualnonlearning sameevidence; StateUpdates actualtransitionupdates; FeatureReads actualselectedvalueconsumptions; failed/fallback counts allscheduledrows. No fabricatedproviderprice; walltime null ifnotactuallymeasured. Sharedrawvalidation costs and work not captured by these counters must be explicitly distinguished, not called totalservicecost.
G2.parent_catalog_contract: The NEW actual activation admission described here is an explicit selected future parent-preparation contract, not a power DYN03 previously had. Copy/read-only state/receipt/cursor values remain unchanged during admission; sort and reseal only the synthetic catalog/index/snapshot before the original activation transition. Admission cannot reactivate invalidated entries, replace revision/content aliases, reset fence epoch/minseq, create missing refs or bypass absent real source evidence. Current/source claims remain synthetic declarations only.
G2.empty_schedule: An explicitly empty schedule still returns one well-formed PredictionRunV2 per selected policy with nonnil predictions=[], matching planned=0 and costcounts0. CLI publishes one fixed prediction file per selectedpolicy and manifest last; zero scheduled work is never pilot readiness or zero-test verification.

snapshot_witness.권고: CLI에서 실제로 소비하는 consistency witness + 모든 정책은 full replay. core RunPolicies/RunPoliciesP1 signature·고정 DTO·hidden IO를 바꾸지 않음.
기본_witness_검증: snapshot role의 실제 ordinary raw bytes/hash/size를 읽어 SnapshotFileV2로 strict decode하고 .Snapshot의 selfhash/typed state·receipt·fence·cursor 검증을 수행한다.

snapshot stream/scope/dimension/source config/clock가 원 source context와 같아야 하며 cursor cutoff는 원 source EventFile의 완전한 prefix 안에 있어야 한다. 원 raw source Event payload에 대응하는 unique receipt eventID/payload/seq/time/key와 source initial/step prefix를 교차검증한다. retries는 receipt를 늘리지 않으며 삭제/스코프 lifecycle 누락을 허용하지 않는다.
이 witness state를 정책 초기값으로 복사하거나 숫자/config/ref만 바꿔 seed로 사용하지 않는다. 각 policy Dynamics로 실제 전체 source projection을 새 replay하므로 self-consistent하지만 사실이 아닌 witness 숫자가 실행 결과에 쓰이지 않는다.
고정 서명에는 snapshot 인자가 없으므로 CLI validation wrapper에서 소비한다. pure core함수는 입력 events/probes/candidates/config만 사용하며 새 file/global/config side channel을 만들지 않는다.
sourcecfg_body: source EventFile.ConfigSHA256와 정확히 같은 DynamicsConfigV2를 cfg.Registry.Entries[].Dynamics에서만 얻는다. 같은 config가 여러 policy entry에 등장하는 경우 typed 동일한 값을 중복명칭 때문에 거부할 필요는 없다.
해당 Dynamics 본문이 없으면 hash문자열로 tau/initial/eta/evidence rule을 복원하거나 외부파일을 탐색하지 않는다. typed/selfhash와 원 prefix binding 검증을 넘어 전체 numeric replay를 했다고 주장하지 않는다.
숫자검산_강한층: sourcecfg body가 실제 있고 동일한 parent catalog/admission history가 명시되어 있을 때만 source full-prefix를 실제 replay해 witness state/receipt/consumption/epoch/minseq/fence와 비교하는 강한 검산이 가능하다. 단순 ReplayPrefix(witness,[],cursor,cfg)는 structural/history 검증이지 원과거 numeric value의 재계산이 아님.

기존 DYN03는 dormant catalog entry와 다양한 accepted synthetic checkpoint를 허용하므로 event만 보고 항상 같은 initial catalog를 복원했다고 말할 수 없다. parent history가 없는 witness를 full numeric-proof로 인정하거나 event-only catalog와 다르다는 이유만으로 모든 정상 synthetic resume를 원 API에서 금지하지 않는다.
불가능한_우회: EventFileV2 validator는 unique seq1부터 연속 full history를 요구한다. suffix arrays 지원은 ReplayPrefix의 별도 []EventV2 API 규범이며 suffix-only를 EventFile로 감싸거나 seq를 다시1로 만들면 안 된다.
CLI가 snapshot으로 shortened suffix부터 runner를 실제 시작하게 하려면 현 signature로 snapshot 전달경로가 없다. 새 명시 API/계약 확장 또는 별도 future wrapper dispatch가 필요하며 숨은 전역·cfg payload·고정 DTO 변경으로 해결하지 않는다.
이 consistency-witness 선택은 전체 DYN03 synthetic full/resume의 원 수용을 철회하지 않으며, 본 native CLI가 checkpoint-start 최적화까지 구현한 것으로 표시하지 않는다.
snapshot_witness.basic_acceptance_scope: Basic witness admission establishes actual raw/type/selfhash and source/cursor/receipt-prefix binding consistency only. Its numeric state is not trusted or copied into policy execution. No numeric historical-authenticity claim without the stronger explicit conditions; no operational restore claim.

G3.inputs: Keep exact compare_runs(run_paths,registry_path). Strictboundedordinaryread, at leasttwo distinctpath/rawhash, verifyselfhashes and actualtypedregistry/versions/decisionconfigassociations. No additional hiddenfile/lookup/data/gold/authority reads. SameRunID across differentpolicies fromonejob is allowed; duplicate(runID,policyID) output objects conflict, not extra independentruns.
G3.comparison_meaning: Checks describe declaredartifactbinding equality and observed decisionconsistency, not reconstructed originalsource bytes/currentpermission/authenticruntime proof. Registry equality is checked againstactualregistry. Shared manifest/config commitments may support events/features/scope/clock/cutoff bindingequality only under that documented meaning; no claim to have inspectedtheir originalvalues.
G3.observed_checks: For commonplannedqueryIDs with successfuldecisionseveryrun, compare candidateSnapshotSHA, contextbudget andcandidate/source-snapshot commitments; preserve distinct derivedpolicy-prefixes rather than requiringrawSHAequality. Ifanyrequiredquery/decision isabsent/failed or manifest/configcommitments differ, unprovablechecks are equal=false/reason=source_unknown, not emptyknownsuccess or evidenceofactualdifferentpermissions. EqualConditions true only when allninechecks established atthisbinding/observablelevel.
G3.denominators: Statuses preserve allplanned/ok/failed/fallback counts, never dropfailed-onlyruns. Candidate/budget/source_snapshot checks forfailed-only are unknown/false. RunIDs sortedunique maycontainonejobIDforseveralpolicyfiles. No winner/score/statistics/REFselection, no independentcausaltruth claim.
G3.all_missing: If no successful comparable decisions exist, candidates/budget/source-snapshot checks are false/source_unknown even if metadata strings are equal. Never treat an empty set of observed successes as known equality. Preserve all failed and scheduled rows/statuses.

source_boundaries.actual_materializer: EXP01 semantic plans are not native inputs. Do not promote material_available or declared fixture approval to an actual product activation/current permission. Native materializer requires its own owner contract.
source_boundaries.trust: Typed hashes and artifact equality do not authenticate current rights, real outcome independence, raw CAS contents or real DB task/run/trial relations. SYS owner guards remain required for operational use.
source_boundaries.execution: Only explicit native synthetic inputs. No provider/model/network/operational DB calls. No gold/split/labels/holdout/env/model access.

required_acceptance: Actual seven-policy execution with the same candidate/evidence/budget/schedule and correctly derived per-policy prefixes
B0 equivalence gate remains unresolved in subnormal case; retain failure until explicit accepted resolution
Role/raw/semantic/context/revision/feature validation, old retries and unknown/failed denominators with literal independent oracles
Snapshot witness mutated numeric values cannot contaminate policy outputs; absent sourcecfg body never creates a claimed numeric proof
CLI explicit flags, secure reads, no overwrite/symlink replacement, actual complete/withfailures output manifest, fixed prediction paths and post-publication stdout-failure preservation
Full replay and original DYN03 full/resume invariants are separately tested; CLI checkpoint-start optimization remains not implemented
Actual Python comparison validates registry/canonical hashes and all nine selected evidence levels without hidden original-file reads or REF/statistical selection
